_doc: What was checked for each pool the brief asked about, and the outcome. Shown on /sources.

items.detail: ZEC listed on miningpoolstats. ZEN pool retired Jul 2025 (archive).
ZEC PPLNS and ZEC solo listed on miningpoolstats; BTG checked via 2Miners API (also on MPS). ZEN and Flux pools retired (archive).
ZEC only (PPS+ 3%, SOLO 1.5%, min payout 0.025 ZEC per pool page). No other Equihash coin on pool.kryptex.com.
ZEC listed on miningpoolstats. Its own /api/status shows Equihash algos but with zero hashrate and no per-coin breakdown, so only MPS rows are used.
Already listed on miningpoolstats for several Equihash coins; public API (zpool.ca/api/currencies) used only to fill coins MPS lacks (none missing in this run).

Not on miningpoolstats. Added for ZEC and WEC (merged mining). Fee from public overview API; hashrate from the public pool hashrate API (https://pool.zecwec.com/api/v1/hashrate/pool), shown on both rows because ZecWec merge-mines ZEC and WEC with the same work. An earlier operator-reported ~0.44 MSol/s figure was dropped.
Not on miningpoolstats. Equihash ASIC pool 'based on Zcash' documented in its support center; hostname resolves. No public hashrate/fee data.
zec.suprnova.cc page exists, but its stats API (zec.suprnova.cc:4008/api/pools) returned HTTP 503 and the old MPOS API returned 404, so current operation could not be verified. Not listed.

Help center still documents a ZEC pool, but api.nanopool.org/v1/zec/* returns 404 while XMR/RVN endpoints return 200, and zec.nanopool.org shows a generic maintenance page. Not listed and not archived (no shutdown announcement could be fetched).
zergpool.com and its API returned Cloudflare 522 (origin unreachable) on every attempt. The refresh script adds ZergPool Equihash coins automatically when the API answers.
Algorithm list on herominers.com has no Equihash variant (only BeamHash III, which is a different PoW).
Solo pools on MPS are included and flagged SOLO (2Miners solo, Kryptex solo, fenixpool, himpool, molepool, mysolopool, kardanpool, solopool.site, etc.).

coins.detail: MPS page exists but shows 0 hashrate and no pools; PoW ended 23 Jul 2025 (migration to Base). Shown as ended.
MPS page lists one pool with 0 hashrate; PoW ended at block 2,020,000 (Oct 2025). Shown as ended; its pool row is in the archive view.
Not included: BeamHash is not listed by miningpoolstats as an Equihash algorithm.
MPS data file is stale (last update 2024) and the coin page returns 404. Not included.
